Class Argon2PasswordEncoderConfigurationProperties

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.security.password.argon2.Argon2PasswordEncoderConfigurationProperties
All Implemented Interfaces:
Argon2PasswordEncoderConfiguration
@ConfigurationProperties("micronaut.security.password.argon2") @Context @ValidArgon2Costs @Internal public final class Argon2PasswordEncoderConfigurationProperties extends Object implements Argon2PasswordEncoderConfiguration
Binds configuration for the Argon2id password encoder.

The configuration is bound and validated when the application context starts, so an invalid configuration prevents the application from starting.

Since:
5.5.0

    • setMemory

      public void setMemory(int memory)
      Sets the memory cost, in kibibytes, used to encode passwords. It must be at least eight times the parallelism and at most the maximum memory. Default value (19456).
      Parameters:
      memory - the memory cost, in kibibytes

    • setMaxMemory

      public void setMaxMemory(int maxMemory)
      Sets the highest memory cost, in kibibytes, accepted when verifying an encoded password. An encoded password that declares a higher memory cost does not match any password. Default value (262144).
      Parameters:
      maxMemory - the highest memory cost, in kibibytes
